notes:
Urban city bus network operated by Pira Mobilidade (Rápido Sumaré / Grupo Belarmino consortium) for Piracicaba, SP, Brazil. SEMUTTRAN is the municipal transit authority. Piracicaba has NO metro/tram/rail/BRT — it is a bus-only urban system (route_type=3 throughout), so the "metro/rail first" directive does not apply here.

DATA PROVENANCE
- Route list: the operator page https://piramobilidade.com.br/linhas-e-horarios/ lists ~68 lines (002-1200) with per-line timetable PDFs. I built 3 representative, fully-evidenced lines rather than 68 stubs.
- Timetables + itineraries: extracted verbatim from the official per-line PDFs (pdftotext -layout):
  * 002 Panorâmica: https://piramobilidade.com.br/.../002-Panoramica.pdf (dated 09/09/2024) — TCI (Plataforma B4) <-> Faculdade de Odontologia (FOP). Weekday times both directions verbatim.
  * 101 Jardim Monumento: https://piramobilidade.com.br/.../101-JARDIM-MONUMENTO.pdf (dated 03/03/2025) — TCI (Plataforma A01) <-> Jardim Monumento. Weekday times both directions verbatim.
  * 200 Cecap TPI TCE: https://piramobilidade.com.br/.../200-CECAP.pdf (dated 29/09/2024) — TPI (Plataforma B03) <-> TCE Cecap/Eldorado. Weekday times both directions verbatim.
- Each PDF has a TRAJETOS section listing the ordered streets/rotatórias/terminals for IDA and VOLTA; I used the named terminals + endpoints as GTFS stops. The many intermediate street segments are named but not individually geolocated in the sources, so I did NOT invent point stops for every avenue — I kept the evidenced terminal/endpoint stops plus a few named landmarks with reliable coordinates. This is why representative trips have coarse stop granularity.

COORDINATES (WGS-84)
- TCI (Terminal Central de Integração "Com. Antônio Romano"), Av. Armando de Salles Oliveira 2001, Centro: from address geocode (~-22.7313,-47.6480).
- TPI (Terminal Piracicamirim "Cesário Brossi"), Av. Prof. Alberto Vollet Sachs 2200: -22.73587,-47.62873 (directory).
- TCE (Terminal Cecap/Eldorado), Al. Marcílio Dias / R. Afonso José Fioravante, CECAP: approx -22.7729,-47.5958 (CECAP-district reference; terminal-exact pin unverified).
- FOP (Faculdade de Odontologia UNICAMP), Av. Limeira 901, Areião: approx -22.718,-47.651 (address-area).
- Jardim Monumento (bairro near Rio Piracicaba, endpoint nr.677): approx -22.705,-47.660 (neighbourhood centroid; PDF endpoint is a street number, no exact pin).
Overpass (OSM highway=bus_stop / route=bus) could NOT be queried — direct outbound network to overpass-api.de/kumi is blocked in this sandbox (only WebFetch/WebSearch reachable), so stop coordinates come from address geocoding via WebSearch, not from OSM nodes. Terminal-exact pins for TCE/FOP/Jardim Monumento should be tightened against OSM/Google before publication.

CALENDAR
- weekday (SEGUNDA A SEXTA), saturday (SÁBADO), sunday (DOMINGOS E FERIADOS) services. Line 002 has no Sunday sheet in the PDF; 101/200 do. Representative trips below use weekday times. Saturday/Sunday times exist in the PDFs and can be added as more trips.

CONFIDENCE 0.55: departure times and route endpoints/directions are faithful to the official 2024/2025 PDFs; the weakness is stop granularity (terminals+endpoints only, not every intermediate stop) and a few approximate terminal coordinates. Only 3 of ~68 lines are built.
